change_log.notes: بازطراحی پوسته کنترل‌پنل: فارسی/RTL، تم روشن+تاریک، IA runtime-backed و Embedded Chat.
Session/logout/key hashing و اصلاحات تراکم UI؛ کلیدهای API فقط hash.
مدیریت Provider، ذخیره تنظیمات و بهبود چیدمان و کنترل‌ها.
بازطراحی فرایندمحور Runtime/Profile/Provider، ثبت Mission/Playbook به‌عنوان مرجع حاکمیتی و آغاز قرارداد نسخه‌دار Provider Profile/Account Instance.
موتور کاوشگر فرایندمحور با Behavior Lab، AI-assisted discovery مبتنی بر مجوز، Routing policy نسخه‌دار و Work Register ضدفراموشی.
بازطراحی رابطه‌محور Control Plane: Browser Runtime grouping، Provider provisioning مرحله‌ای، حذف ورودی خام CDP/Profile و ثبت غیرفعال تا Certification.
Mission-driven Control Plane audit: human-understandable entity relationships, readiness/certification gating, actual service topology and structured Evidence separation.
Embedded Chat canonical uploads, provider-side Stop/cancellation, User-View discovery states و media qualification عملیاتی.
Release closure candidate: outbound traffic observability, honest token telemetry, DeepSeek readiness revalidation, synchronized release metadata.
RC2 supersedes RC1 after documentation encoding defect was detected during GitHub verification; no production cutover occurred.
RC3 adds explicit production deployment-profile isolation for port 5000 and Windows service configuration.
E2 operational release after controlled production cutover, verified rollback/restore, production restart recovery, and bounded provider smoke. E3 reliability is not claimed.
Final E2 operational release after RC4 exact preflight, controlled cutover, rollback/restore and production restart recovery. E3 reliability not claimed.
Post-2.1.0 full-panel audit remediation: fail-closed service controls, runtime-gated account readiness, explicit model loading state, and raw YAML accessibility labels.
Full-panel audit pass 2: complete Models capability matrix across registered providers and contain Overview charts/status labels at responsive widths.
Full-product audit pass 3: encoding-safe provider routing labels and independent Session/Readiness evidence timestamps on Account cards.
Encoding-safe correction of all Persian labels introduced by the full-product audit; preserves pass-3 Session/Readiness evidence separation.
Synchronize provider-certification test contract with the valid Production W2 replacement while preserving E3_IN_PROGRESS until W3.
Full-product audit safety: bind all service-manager status/start/stop actions to the active HWG_CONFIG_PATH deployment profile to prevent Dev/Production target confusion.
